engagement.client: Solstice Financial Services (SYNTHETIC - fictitious entity created for AssureAI pilot testing; not a real client)

risk.risk_description: Excessive or inappropriate privileged/administrative access may go undetected without independent oversight.

control.control_objective: To ensure that privileged/administrative access assignments are reviewed quarterly by an individual independent of the privileged-access provisioning process, to confirm continued business need.
control.suggested_control_description: Quarterly review of admin access by independent reviewer.
control.suggested_test_procedures_tod: Inspect the RACM and walkthrough documentation to confirm the control is designed so that privileged access is reviewed quarterly by an individual independent of the provisioning process.
control.suggested_test_procedures_toe: For a sample of quarters, inspect the signed-off access review spreadsheet to confirm the review was performed, and corroborate the identity and independence of the reviewer.
